text:
Hi Guys, think of it rather like this. If I have a double top forming
or similar. I want to see room between the two. So I don't want the trap
 to be forming in my kink :)

author: Edge
text:
So I didn't get the reaction I wanted. But it was a free trade as it
still bounced enough back to the mouth of the triple top. This just goes
 to show how we can have very low risk trading. I can walk away without
losing a cent. Its important to see how nothing else out there compares
to RTM

author: Edge
text:
For those price nerds like me who enjoy the puzzle more than the
trading. This is an exercise I like to do. Almost like a sports team at
half time. Who is leading. Which kink has more chances of success with
clean orders (caveat - not a strategy within itself but shows which
kink has the probability of winning? Anyone want to have a shot at who
is leading at half time. is it RED or GREEN (remember this is only one
factor and is not worthy of trading as a strategy in of itself).HINT -
it has nothing to do with what price is doing in between the kinks

author: Enlightenme
text:
Hi Edge

I hope you don't mind me trying.

I am not sure I understand your statement "it has nothing to do with
what price is doing between the kinks" so I will apologize ahead of
time.

My first thoughts are- given that I drew Green team's clean order # 1
right, I believe it is a tie with green and red team having 2 clean
orders.

Despite my initial thoughts, the clean orders mentioned are small tricks
 and it seems the red team is doing the big time robbery evident in the
break of HTF FL and then creation of the HTF LSK. Furthermore, price
reacted favorably on its FTB to HTF LSK by creating a new LTF QM. So I
think red team is leading. With the MPL at the upper most having the
probability of winning.

-EM
